module_summary: 64-bit UDP receive deparser: an FSM latches parallel IP header fields, extracts the UDP header from the first 64-bit payload word, then forwards length-trimmed payload (tkeep masked by word count) through a skid-buffer output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main FSM: idle, read UDP header word, read payload, payload last, wait last.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Input IP header valid; accepted in IDLE to latch header fields.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: IP header ready in IDLE when output header slot is free.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input 64-bit payload: first word holds UDP header, rest is payload.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte enables; masked by remaining count and checked for short frames.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input payload valid gating header capture and payload transfer.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input payload ready from FSM, follows output skid-buffer readiness.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End-of-frame marker; detects early termination, returns FSM to idle.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output UDP header valid after first payload word captured.

anchors.name: m_udp_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready clears header valid.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output 64-bit UDP payload from skid-buffer output register.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid-buffer output register.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling skid-buffer transfers and early ready.

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload bytes from UDP length; masks tkeep and detects mismatch.

anchors.name: m_udp_source_port_reg
anchors.why: Representative UDP header field captured from first payload word.

anchors.name: m_ip_source_ip_reg
anchors.why: Representative latched IP/Ethernet header field passed to outputs.

anchors.name: store_ip_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable latching all parallel IP header fields.

anchors.name: store_hdr_word_0
anchors.why: Load enable capturing UDP header fields from first payload word.

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds final payload word until frame tlast arrives.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tkeep_int
anchors.why: Internal tkeep trimmed by count2keep of remaining word count.

anchors.name: m_udp_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready steering skid buffer stores.

anchors.name: temp_m_udp_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid-buffer temp data register used when output stalled.

anchors.name: store_udp_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Loads internal payload directly into output register.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy when FSM not idle.

anchors.name: error_header_early_termination
anchors.why: Error pulse: frame ended within UDP header word.

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Error pulse: frame shorter than UDP length.

groups.name: Receive FSM
groups.description: Sequences IP header latch, UDP header word capture, and payload length tracking.

groups.name: Header field registers
groups.description: Latched Ethernet/IP fields and UDP ports, length, checksum driving outputs.

groups.name: Payload output skid buffer
groups.description: Trims last-word tkeep and buffers payload in a two-register AXI skid buffer.
